info.title: Metance Universal API
info.description: Connect Metance to read workspace dashboards, sessions, content, topics, folders, content sets, company data, and files from your corporate memory workspace.

get.description: Retrieves content from Metance by ID.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Metance content identifier.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
